name: probe-selftest
about: Repro playbook 1.4: a throw inside a probe verb becomes a failed reply, and the game and the probe keep going. Also the TIMEOUT path's partner: a plain fast run.

steps.name: a throwing verb returns a failed reply
the probe still answers after the throw
the game is still in town
the heartbeat counts the caught exception
no script errors in our files (the throw was caught)
